proposals.title: Core branded integer types and arithmetic with division rounding modes
proposals.why_now: Every other package in the monorepo depends on @ciclo/core for nominal types and arithmetic. Currently core exports only CanonicalEncoder. Nothing in world, domain, or application can be implemented until Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick branded types exist, the division helper with explicit rounding mode exists (ADR-004 DEFINIR), and overflow guards exist. This is the hard dependency root of the entire FASE-1 critical path.

acceptance_targets: ADR written specifying the hash function bit-by-bit (SplitMix64 over FNV-1a accumulator per ADR-002 recommendation)
rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) exported from @ciclo/core; coordinates are Tick-safe integers; result is a safe integer in [0, 2^53-1]
All 11 namespaces from the spec table are registered as typed constants
Property test: rand with the same arguments always returns the same value; rand with different coordinates always produces distinct values over a large sample
No Math.random, no Date, no mutable state — enforced by existing lint
INV-12 satisfied: every identifier derivable from (seed, tick, sequence) without external entropy
proposals.title: Positional RNG implementation and ADR for hash function
proposals.why_now: The spec identifies INV-02 — consulting price(asset, t) directly equals arriving at t tick by tick — as 'the most important test of the project'. That invariant requires a positional RNG. ADR-002 marks the hash function as DEFINIR with a strong recommendation of SplitMix64 over FNV-1a. Without the RNG, the price generator, bot policies, macro events, and NPC tips cannot be started. This is the second hard dependency of the FASE-1 critical path.

Property test: 1000 random sequences of transactions preserve INV-05 (BRL sum = 0) and INV-06 (per-asset quantity sum = 0)

No transaction is orphaned: causationId is required and typed
proposals.title: Multi-commodity double-entry ledger
proposals.why_now: The ledger is the source of truth for all economic state (INV-04 through INV-07). It must exist before market orders, the tick loop, or any save/replay work. Its interface is well-specified: Transaction, Entry, Account, per-commodity balance-zero invariant, causationId on every transaction. The domain package is entirely stub; this is its first substantive deliverable. It can proceed in parallel with IDEA-002 since it depends only on IDEA-001 (Money, Quantity, Price types).

proposals.title: Electron application bootstrap and FASE-1 minimum installer
proposals.why_now: The spec states explicitly: 'o instalador existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim. Se o empacotamento multiplataforma aparecer depois, o time descobre problema de módulo nativo, de ABI e de caminho de arquivo na última semana, quando já não há tempo de corrigir arquitetura.' All four desktop apps are export{} stubs. INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration=false, sandbox=true) cannot be tested until an Electron bootstrap exists. The window between domain logic and installer is a known failure mode for Electron projects. This can proceed independently of domain packages.

spec_refs: §19 lacunas conhecidas — number of octaves and generator parameters are DEFINIR
proposals.title: Price generator with two assets and two noise layers
proposals.why_now: INV-02 — the spec's self-described most important test — requires the price generator to be consultable positionally: price(asset, t) must equal arriving at t tick by tick for any t and any asset. The fractal octave construction (trendLayer + idiosyncraticNoise) is the first substantive use of the positional RNG and the first use of fixed-point arithmetic in the world package. Two noise layers and two assets are the minimum for FASE-1 acceptance. This requires IDEA-001 and IDEA-002 to be complete first.

repository_assessment.current_state: Infrastructure and tooling are complete: monorepo skeleton, TypeScript strict mode, determinism lint (§13 rules), dependency boundary lint (§14.5), and CanonicalEncoder with ADR-009 accepted. All eight packages, four desktop apps, and three tools exist as typed stubs. Five test suites pass. No domain logic has been implemented: core has only CanonicalEncoder, world/domain/application/narrative/contracts/adapters/ui are export{} stubs, all Electron apps are empty, and tools/replay and tools/bench have no implementation.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: The @ciclo/core package lacks the foundational nominal integer types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick) and the division helper with explicit rounding modes that every other package depends on. Until these exist, no work in world, domain, or application can proceed.

warnings: ADR-004 requires that calling division without an explicit rounding mode be 'an error de compilação ou erro de lint bloqueante' — the enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR and must be decided by ADR before core arithmetic is implemented. A lint rule over the bare / operator on branded types is one approach; a typed helper function that requires the mode parameter is another. The decision affects how the lint rule set needs to be extended.

ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists. The spec recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a but this is a recommendation, not a decision. An ADR must be written and the choice must be immutable once any hash of state exists, because changing it retroactively invalidates all reference StateHash values.

The price generator (§5.1) requires fixed-point implementations of functions equivalent to Math.sin, Math.cos, Math.exp, or lookup-table interpolation — all of which must produce bit-identical results on Windows and Linux under the same Electron/V8 version (INV-19). The approach must be decided by ADR (this is the DEFINIR for 'funções transcendentais') before implementation begins, since the choice affects every price value ever produced.
